question.problem:
$$
{f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,1.5)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3(1+2{y}^{2})}{5}, & \,0\le y\le 1 \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. Find the conditional expected value $\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1.5]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1.5)$ is shown above.
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional expected value of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=x]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }y\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)\,\text{d}y.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[Y\,|\,X=1.5] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }y\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,1.5)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}y\cdot \frac{3(1+2{y}^{2})}{5}\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{5}{\int }_{0}^{1}(y+2{y}^{3})\,\text{d}y \\  & =\frac{3}{5}{[\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}+\frac{{y}^{4}}{2}]}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\frac{3}{5}(\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2}-0) \\  & =\frac{3}{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
